// Tim Fischer <fischeti@iis.ee.ethz.ch>

/// A FIFO buffer with configurable depth
module floo_fifo #(
  parameter int unsigned  NumChannels     = 32'd2, // 2 for bi-directional channels
  parameter int unsigned  NumVirtChannels = 32'd1,
  parameter int unsigned  NumPhysChannels = 32'd1,
  parameter int unsigned  FifoDepth       = 32'd1,
  parameter type          flit_t          = logic
) (
  input  logic clk_i,
  input  logic rst_ni,
  input  logic test_enable_i,

  input  logic [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0] valid_i,
  output logic [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0] ready_o,
  input  flit_t[NumChannels-1:0][NumPhysChannels-1:0] data_i,

  output logic [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0] valid_o,
  input  logic [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0] ready_i,
  output flit_t[NumChannels-1:0][NumPhysChannels-1:0] data_o
);

  if (FifoDepth == 0) begin : gen_no_fifo
    // Degenerate case
    assign valid_o = valid_i;
    assign ready_o = ready_i;
    assign data_o  = data_i;
  end else begin : gen_floo_fifo

    // Generate the buffers
    if (NumPhysChannels == 1) begin : gen_virt_channels

      logic [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0]  ready_in, valid_out;
      flit_t [NumChannels-1:0][NumVirtChannels-1:0] data_out;

      for (genvar n = 0; n < NumChannels; n++) begin : gen_channel
        for (genvar v = 0; v < NumVirtChannels; v++) begin : gen_virt_channel
          cc_stream_fifo #(
            .Depth        ( FifoDepth ),
            .data_t            ( flit_t    ),
            .FallThrough ( 1'b0      )
          ) i_stream_fifo (
            .clk_i      ( clk_i           ),
            .rst_ni     ( rst_ni          ),
            .flush_i    ( 1'b0            ),
            .usage_o    (                 ),
            .data_i     ( data_i[n]       ),
            .valid_i    ( valid_i[n][v]   ),
            .ready_o    ( ready_o[n][v]   ),
            .data_o     ( data_out[n][v]  ),
            .valid_o    ( valid_out[n][v] ),
            .ready_i    ( ready_in[n][v]  )
          );
        end

        // TODO(fischeti): Is an arbiter necessary here?
        floo_vc_arbiter #(
          .NumVirtChannels(NumVirtChannels),
          .flit_t(flit_t)
        ) i_floo_vc_arbiter (
          .clk_i      ( clk_i         ),
          .rst_ni     ( rst_ni        ),
          .valid_i    ( valid_out[n]  ),
          .ready_o    ( ready_in[n]   ),
          .data_i     ( data_out[n]   ),
          .data_o     ( data_o[n]     ),
          .valid_o    ( valid_o[n]    ),
          .ready_i    ( ready_i[n]    ),
          .credit_i   ( '0            )
        );
      end
    end else if (NumVirtChannels == NumPhysChannels) begin : gen_phys_channels
      for (genvar n = 0; n < NumChannels; n++) begin : gen_channel
        for (genvar v = 0; v < NumVirtChannels; v++) begin : gen_virt_channel
          cc_stream_fifo #(
            .Depth        ( FifoDepth ),
            .data_t            ( flit_t    ),
            .FallThrough ( 1'b0      )
          ) i_stream_fifo (
            .clk_i      ( clk_i         ),
            .rst_ni     ( rst_ni        ),
            .flush_i    ( 1'b0          ),
            .usage_o    (               ),
            .data_i     ( data_i[n][v]  ),
            .valid_i    ( valid_i[n][v] ),
            .ready_o    ( ready_o[n][v] ),
            .data_o     ( data_o[n][v]  ),
            .valid_o    ( valid_o[n][v] ),
            .ready_i    ( ready_i[n][v] )
          );
        end
      end
    end else begin : gen_not_supported
      $fatal(1, "unimplemented");
    end
  end

endmodule

The configured top elaborates a 23-bit packed `flit_t` (13-bit payload + 8-bit tag + 2-bit flags) from [top.sv:3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:3).

| `floo_fifo` instance | Effective `data_i` / `valid_i` width | Selected generate branch | Elaborated `cc_stream_fifo` / `floo_vc_arbiter` count |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `u_virtual` | 69 b (`3×1×23`) / 12 b (`3×4`) | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels` | 12 / 3 |
| `u_physical` | 138 b (`2×3×23`) / 6 b (`2×3`) | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels` | 6 / 0 |
| `u_bypass` | 46 b (`2×1×23`) / 8 b (`2×4`) | `gen_no_fifo` | 0 / 0 |

The precedence is outer `FifoDepth == 0` first; otherwise `NumPhysChannels == 1`; otherwise `NumVirtChannels == NumPhysChannels`; otherwise `gen_not_supported` ([floo_fifo.sv:28](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:28), [floo_fifo.sv:36](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:36)). Thus `u_bypass` takes `gen_no_fifo` despite having one physical channel.

4. Virtual `n=2,v=3`:

`floo_config_top.u_virtual.gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels.gen_channel[2].gen_virt_channel[3].i_stream_fifo`

Its effective parameters are `Depth=5`, `FallThrough=0`. The direct source actuals are exactly `data_i[n]` and `data_out[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:52), [floo_fifo.sv:55](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:55)). Here `n` and `v` are the source genvars; this elaborated path fixes them to 2 and 3. Therefore the input selection is `data_i[2]` (its sole physical-lane slice), while the output selection is `data_out[2][3]`.

5. Physical `n=1,v=2`:

`floo_config_top.u_physical.gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels.gen_channel[1].gen_virt_channel[2].i_stream_fifo`

Its effective `Depth=2` (`FallThrough=0`). The source actuals are `data_i[n][v]` and `data_o[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:89](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:89), [floo_fifo.sv:92](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:92)); at this generated instance they select `[1][2]`.

6. The virtual FIFO’s `cc_fifo` child is:

`floo_config_top.u_virtual.gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels.gen_channel[2].gen_virt_channel[3].i_stream_fifo.fifo_i`

It has 3-bit read/write pointers, a 3-bit status counter, and a 115-bit packed `mem_q` (`data_t[4:0]`). For `Depth=5`, `FifoDepth=(Depth>0)?Depth:1=5`; `PtrWidth=idx_width(5)=$clog2(5)=3`; and `UsageWidth=cnt_width(5)=idx_width(6)=$clog2(6)=3` ([cc_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:43), [cc_pkg.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cc_pkg.sv:43)). `mem_q` is five packed 23-bit structured flits, hence `5×23=115` bits ([cc_fifo.sv:53](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:53)).

7. These are integration overrides, not `floo_fifo` declaration defaults. The declaration defaults are `(NumChannels, NumVirtChannels, NumPhysChannels, FifoDepth)=(2,1,1,1)` with `flit_t=logic` (one bit) ([floo_fifo.sv:8](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:8)). The integration instead supplies `(3,4,1,5,23b)`, `(2,3,3,2,23b)`, and `(2,4,1,0,23b)` respectively ([top.sv:9](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/top.sv:9)). The stream FIFO’s untouched `DataWidth=32` default does not make these flits 32 bits, because its `data_t` is explicitly overridden with the 23-bit `flit_t`.

8. `clr_i` is not explicitly connected on any of the 18 generated stream FIFOs; both instantiation templates omit it ([floo_fifo.sv:47](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:47), [floo_fifo.sv:84](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:84)). The child `cc_fifo` does receive its parent stream FIFO’s `clr_i` via `.clr_i` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:55](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cc_stream_fifo.sv:55)), but that parent port is itself unconnected. If asserted, the implementation clears pointer/count state and memory ([cc_fifo.sv:120](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/mcp+skill/rep_1/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:120)); this fragment does not establish a valid clear source, a tied-low value, or actual clear events. This is a missing port connection, not a missing FIFO definition: both `cc_stream_fifo` and `cc_fifo` are present and elaborated.
